questions.stem: 设 \( f\left(\frac{1}{x}\right) = x + \sqrt{1 + x^2} (x \neq 0) \)，则 \( x = 0 \) 是 \( f(x) \) 的

solution.analysis_md:
令 \(\frac{1}{x} = t\) ，则 \(f(t) = \frac{1}{t} +\frac{\sqrt{1 + t^2}}{|t|},t\neq 0,\)
于是  \( f(x)=\left\{\begin{aligned}&\frac{1+\sqrt{1+x^{2}}}{x},&x>0,\\&\frac{1-\sqrt{1+x^{2}}}{x},&x<0.\end{aligned}\right. \)
由于 \(\lim_{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{1 + \sqrt{1 + x^2}}{x} = +\infty ,\lim_{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{1 - \sqrt{1 + x^2}}{x} = 0,\)
故 x=0 为  \( f(x) \)  的第二类间断点.

options.A: 点 \((0,0)\) 是 \(f(x,y)\) 的唯一极小值点, 也是其最小值点.
options.B: 点 \((0,0)\) 是 \(f(x,y)\) 的唯一极大值点, 也是其最大值点.
options.C: 点 \((0,0)\) 是 \(f(x,y)\) 的唯一极小值点, 但不是其最小值点.
options.D: 点 \((0,0)\) 是 \(f(x,y)\) 的唯一极大值点, 但不是其最大值点.

solution.analysis_md:
令  \( f_{x}^{\prime}(x,y)=2x+3y^{2}(1+x)^{2}=0,f_{y}^{\prime}(x,y)=2y(1+x)^{3}=0 \)
可知(0,0)是其唯一驻点.因为
\[
f _ {x x} ^ {\prime \prime} (x, y) = 2 + 6 y ^ {2} (1 + x), f _ {x y} ^ {\prime \prime} (x, y) = 6 y (1 + x) ^ {2}, f _ {y y} ^ {\prime \prime} (x, y) = 2 (1 + x) ^ {3},
\]
故 \(A = f_{xx}^{\prime \prime}(0,0) = 2,B = f_{xy}^{\prime \prime}(0,0) = 0,C = f_{yy}^{\prime \prime}(0,0) = 2,AC - B^{2} = 4 > 0,A > 0,\)
则(0,0)为 \( f(x,y) \) 的唯一极小值点.又 \( f(0,0)=0,f(-2,3)=-5 \) ，显然(0,0)不是 \( f(x,y) \) 的最小值点.
【注】一元函数中“若函数连续,则唯一的极值必为最值”在多元函数中不成立.

questions.stem:
若 \(\{x_{n}\}, \{y_{n}\}\) 满足 \(\lim_{n \to \infty} x_{n} y_{n} = \infty\), 则以下结论:
①  \( \lim_{n\to\infty}x_{n}=\infty \)  或  \( \lim_{n\to\infty}y_{n}=\infty; \)
②  \( \lim_{n\to\infty}x_n=\infty \)  且  \( \lim_{n\to\infty}y_n=\infty; \)
③ \(x_{n}\) 与 \(y_{n}\) 中一个是无穷大量, 另一个是无界量; ④当 \(x_{n}\) 是非零无穷小量时, \(\lim_{n\to\infty}y_n = \infty\).
正确结论的个数为

solution.analysis_md:
取 \(x_{n} = n^{\frac{1 + (-1)^{n}}{2}},y_{n} = n^{\frac{1 - (-1)^{n}}{2}},n = 1,2,\dots\) ，则
\[
\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} x _ {n} y _ {n} = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} n = \infty ,
\]
但 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}x_n\) 与 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}y_n\) 均不存在，且不为 \(\infty\) ，故①，②，③均不正确.
又当 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}x_n = 0(x_n\neq 0)\) 时， \(\lim_{n\to \infty}y_n = \lim_{n\to \infty}\left(x_ny_n\cdot \frac{1}{x_n}\right) = \infty \cdot \infty = \infty\) ，④正确.选A.
参考答案与分析 卷(五)

questions.stem: 设 \(p, q\) 为正常数, 若 \(\int_{0}^{1} \frac{1}{x^{p} |\ln x|^{q}} \mathrm{d}x\) 收敛, 则

solution.analysis_md:
由于 \(0 < x < 1\)，因此 \(\ln x < 0\)，令 \(\ln x = -t (t > 0)\)，\(x = \mathrm{e}^{-t}\)，有
\[
\begin{array}{l} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1}{x ^ {p} | \ln x | ^ {q}} \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {+ \infty} ^ {0} \frac {- \mathrm{e} ^ {- t}}{\mathrm{e} ^ {- p t} \bullet t ^ {q}} \mathrm{d} t = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {(p - 1) t}}{t ^ {q}} \mathrm{d} t \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {(p - 1) t}}{t ^ {q}} \mathrm{d} t + \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {(p - 1) t}}{t ^ {q}} \mathrm{d} t. \\ \end{array}
\]
对于 \(\int_0^1\frac{\mathrm{e}^{(p - 1)t}}{t^q}\mathrm{d}t\) ，等价于研究 \(\int_0^1\frac{1}{t^q}\mathrm{d}t\) ，故当 \(q < 1\) 时，收敛.
对于 \(\int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{e}^{(p - 1)t}}{t^q}\mathrm{d}t\) ，当 \(p < 1\) 时，必收敛；
当 \(p = 1\) 时，\(q > 1\) 才能使其收敛，这时 \(\int_0^1\frac{1}{t^q}\mathrm{d}t\) 发散，故 \(p\neq 1\)
当p>1时，必发散.
综上所述，p<1，q<1。

questions.stem: 设函数 \( y = f(x) \) 由参数方程 \( \left\{ \begin{array}{l} x = t^3 + \frac{\pi}{2} - 1, \\ y = \mathrm{e}^{t^2} \end{array} \right. \) 确定，则 \( \lim_{n\to \infty}n\left[f\left(\frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{2}{n}\right) - f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)\right] = \)

solution.analysis_md:
\( f'(x)=\frac{\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t}}{\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t}}=\frac{2\mathrm{e}^{t^{2}}}{3t^{2}}=\frac{2\mathrm{e}^{t^{2}}}{3t} \) ，当 \( x=\frac{\pi}{2} \) 时，t=1．则
\[
f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {\pi}{2}\right) = \frac {2 \mathrm{e} ^ {t ^ {2}}}{3 t} \Bigg | _ {t = 1} = \frac {2 \mathrm{e}}{3},
\]
\[
\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} n \left[ f \left(\frac {\pi}{2} + \frac {2}{n}\right) - f \left(\frac {\pi}{2}\right)\right] = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {f \left(\frac {\pi}{2} + \frac {2}{n}\right) - f \left(\frac {\pi}{2}\right)}{\frac {2}{n}} \cdot 2 = 2 f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {\pi}{2}\right) = \frac {4 e}{3}.
\]

questions.stem: 设函数 \( f(x) = \int_{0}^{\sin x} \mathrm{e}^{t^2} \sin t dt, g(x) = \int_{0}^{x} \mathrm{e}^{t^2} \sin 2x dt \), 则

options.A: \(f(x)\) 是奇函数, \(g(x)\) 是奇函数.
options.B: \(f(x)\) 是偶函数, \(g(x)\) 是奇函数.
options.C: \(f(x)\) 是偶函数, \(g(x)\) 是偶函数.
options.D: \(f(x)\) 是奇函数, \(g(x)\) 是偶函数.

solution.analysis_md:
\(f(-x) = \int_{0}^{\sin (-x)}\mathrm{e}^{t^2}\sin t\mathrm{d}t = \int_{0}^{-\sin x}\mathrm{e}^{t^2}\sin t\mathrm{d}t,\)
令 \(t = -u\) ，则
\[
f (- x) = \int_ {0} ^ {\sin x} \mathrm{e} ^ {(- u) ^ {2}} \sin (- u) \bullet (- \mathrm{d} u) = \int_ {0} ^ {\sin x} \mathrm{e} ^ {u ^ {2}} \sin u \mathrm{d} u = f (x),
\]
可得 \( f(x) \) 为偶函数.
\(g(x) = \sin^2 x \cdot \int_0^x e^{t^2} \, \mathrm{d}t\)。令 \(h(x) = \int_0^x e^{t^2} \, \mathrm{d}t\)，则 \(h(-x) = \int_0^{-x} e^{t^2} \, \mathrm{d}t\)。令 \(t = -u\)，得
\[
h (- x) = - \int_ {0} ^ {x} \mathrm{e} ^ {u ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} u = - h (x),
\]
可得  \( h(x) \)  为奇函数, 则  \( g(x)=h(x)\sin^{2}x \)  为奇函数.
综上,应选B.

questions.stem: 设 \(A, B\) 为 \(n\) 阶矩阵, 且 \(A\) 满足 \(A^2 - A = 3E\), 则与 \(\binom{A}{B} x = 0\) 不一定同解的是

solution.analysis_md:
由 \(A^2 - A = 3E\) 可得 \((A + E)(A - 2E) = E\), 故 \(A + E\) 和 \(A - 2E\) 均可逆.
对于选项A, \( \begin{pmatrix}A-B\\A+AB\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}E&-E\\E&A\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}A\\B\end{pmatrix} \) ，其中 \( \begin{pmatrix}E&-E\\E&A\end{pmatrix}\rightarrow\begin{pmatrix}E&-E\\O&A+E\end{pmatrix} \) ，由 \( \begin{pmatrix}E&-E\\O&A+E\end{pmatrix} \)
可逆, 得  \( \begin{pmatrix} E & -E \\ E & A \end{pmatrix} \)  可逆, 于是  \( \begin{pmatrix} A-B \\ A+AB \end{pmatrix} x = \begin{pmatrix} E & -E \\ E & A \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} A \\ B \end{pmatrix} x = 0 \)  与  \( \begin{pmatrix} A \\ B \end{pmatrix} x = 0 \)  同解.
对于选项B, \(\left( \begin{array}{cc}A + B\\ A + AB - B \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{cc}E & E\\ E & A - E \end{array} \right)\left( \begin{array}{c}A\\ B \end{array} \right)\) ，其中 \(\left( \begin{array}{cc}E & E\\ E & A - E \end{array} \right)\rightarrow \left( \begin{array}{cc}E & E\\ O & A - 2E \end{array} \right),\)
由 \( \begin{pmatrix}E&E\\O&A-2E\end{pmatrix} \) 可逆,知 \( \begin{pmatrix}A+B\\A+AB-B\end{pmatrix}x=0 \) 与 \( \begin{pmatrix}A\\B\end{pmatrix}x=0 \) 同解.
对于选项C, \( \begin{pmatrix}A-B\\2A+B\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}E&-E\\2E&E\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}A\\B\end{pmatrix} \) ，其中 \( \begin{pmatrix}E&-E\\2E&E\end{pmatrix}\rightarrow\begin{pmatrix}E&-E\\3E&O\end{pmatrix} \) ，由 \( \begin{pmatrix}E&-E\\3E&O\end{pmatrix} \)
可逆, 知  \( \begin{pmatrix} A-B \\ 2A+B \end{pmatrix} x=0 \)  与  \( \begin{pmatrix} A \\ B \end{pmatrix} x=0 \)  同解.
对于选项D， \(\left( \begin{array}{ll}A + B\\ BA + B^2 \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{ll}E & E\\ B & B \end{array} \right)\left( \begin{array}{ll}A\\ B \end{array} \right)\) ，其中 \(\left( \begin{array}{ll}E & E\\ B & B \end{array} \right)\rightarrow \left( \begin{array}{ll}E & O\\ B & O \end{array} \right)\) ，由 \(\left( \begin{array}{ll}E & O\\ B & O \end{array} \right)\) 不可
参考答案与分析 卷(五)

questions.stem: 设 \(A = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 & a \\ b & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & c & 3 \end{pmatrix}\), 其中 \(abc = -6\), 则 \(A\) 的伴随矩阵 \(A^{*}\) 有非零特征值

solution.analysis_md:
因 \(abc = -6\) ，故
\[
| \boldsymbol {A} | = \left| \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 0 & a \\ b & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & c & 3 \end{array} \right| = 6 + a b c = 0, r (\boldsymbol {A}) <   3.
\]
又 \(A_{11} = \left| \begin{array}{ll}2 & 0\\ c & 3 \end{array} \right| = 6\neq 0\) ，则 \(\pmb {r}(\pmb {A}) = 2\) ， \(r(\pmb {A}^{*}) = 1\)
故 \(A^{*}\) 有特征值 \(\lambda_{1} = \lambda_{2} = 0\)
\[
\lambda_ {3} = \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {3} A _ {i i} = A _ {1 1} + A _ {2 2} + A _ {3 3} = \left| \begin{array}{l l} 2 & 0 \\ c & 3 \end{array} \right| + \left| \begin{array}{l l} 1 & a \\ 0 & 3 \end{array} \right| + \left| \begin{array}{l l} 1 & 0 \\ b & 2 \end{array} \right| = 6 + 3 + 2 = 1 1.
\]
二、填空题

questions.stem: 已知函数 \( y = y(x) \) 满足 \( y' - 2\sqrt{2} x\sqrt{y} = 0 \)，且该曲线的一个拐点的横坐标为 -2，则 \( y(x) = \) ____.
\(\int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{1}{x(x + 2)}\mathrm{d}x =\)

solution.analysis_md: \(\int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{1}{x(x + 2)}\mathrm{d}x = \frac{1}{2}\int_{1}^{+\infty}\left(\frac{1}{x} -\frac{1}{x + 2}\right)\mathrm{d}x = \frac{1}{2}\ln \frac{x}{x + 2}\bigg|_{1}^{+\infty} = -\frac{1}{2}\ln \frac{1}{3} = \frac{1}{2}\ln 3.\)

由题, 易知  \( \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=2ax^{3}y^{3}-3y^{2}+5,\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=3x^{4}y^{2}-2bxy-4 \) , 则
\[
\frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial x \partial y} = 6 a x ^ {3} y ^ {2} - 6 y, \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial y \partial x} = 1 2 x ^ {3} y ^ {2} - 2 b y.
\]
显然 \(\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x\partial y}\) 和 \(\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial y\partial x}\) 连续，于是 \(\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x\partial y} = \frac{\partial^2u}{\partial y\partial x}\)，故得 \(a = 2, b = 3\)。
则 \(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = 4x^{3}y^{3} - 3y^{2} + 5,\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = 3x^{4}y^{2} - 6xy - 4.\)
故 \(u(x,y) = \int \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\mathrm{d}x = \int (4x^3 y^3 -3y^2 +5)\mathrm{d}x = x^4 y^3 -3xy^2 +5x + C(y),\)
于是可得 \(\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = 3x^4 y^2 - 6xy + C'(y)\)，又由 \(\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = 3x^4 y^2 - 6xy - 4\) 可知 \(C'(y) = -4\)，则
\[
C (y) = - 4 y + C.
\]
故 \(u(x,y) = x^4 y^3 -3xy^2 +5x - 4y + C.\)

questions.stem: \(\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{1}{n^3}\left[\ln \frac{1}{n} +4\ln \frac{2}{n} +\dots +(n - 1)^2\ln \frac{n - 1}{n}\right] =\)

solution.analysis_md:
原式 \(= \lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{1}{n}\cdot \left[\frac{1^2}{n^2}\ln \frac{1}{n} +\frac{2^2}{n^2}\ln \frac{2}{n} +\dots +\frac{(n - 1)^2}{n^2}\ln \frac{n - 1}{n} +\frac{n^2}{n^2}\ln \frac{n}{n}\right]\)
\[
= \int_ {0} ^ {1} x ^ {2} \ln x \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \ln x \mathrm{d} \left(\frac {x ^ {3}}{3}\right)
\]
\[
= \frac {x ^ {3}}{3} \ln x \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {1} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {x ^ {3}}{3} \cdot \frac {1}{x} d x
\]
\[
= - \frac {1}{9}.
\]

questions.stem: 设 \(A = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}, B = \begin{pmatrix} -1 & 1 \\ 0 & -1 \end{pmatrix}\), 则 \(A^9 - B^9 =\) ____.

solution.analysis_md:
\(A^9 = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 9 \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}, B^9 = \begin{pmatrix} -1 & 9 \\ 0 & -1 \end{pmatrix}\), 故 \(A^9 - B^9 = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 \end{pmatrix}\).
三、解答题

(1)设D的面积为S,则
\[
\begin{array}{l} S = \int_ {\sqrt {2}} ^ {2} \frac {\sqrt {x ^ {2} - 1}}{x ^ {2}} d x \stackrel {x = \sec t} {=} \int_ {\frac {\pi}{4}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{3}} \frac {\tan t}{\sec^ {2} t} \sec t \tan t d t = \int_ {\frac {\pi}{4}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{3}} \frac {\tan^ {2} t}{\sec t} d t \\ = \int_ {\frac {\pi}{4}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{3}} \frac {\sin^ {2} t}{\cos t} d t = \int_ {\frac {\pi}{4}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{3}} \frac {1 - \cos^ {2} t}{\cos t} d t = \int_ {\frac {\pi}{4}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{3}} (\sec t - \cos t) d t \\ = \ln | \sec t + \tan t | \left| \frac {\frac {\pi}{3}}{4} - \sin t \right| \frac {\frac {\pi}{3}}{4} = \ln \frac {2 + \sqrt {3}}{1 + \sqrt {2}} - \frac {\sqrt {3} - \sqrt {2}}{2} \\ = \ln \left[ (\sqrt {3} + 2) (\sqrt {2} - 1) \right] - \frac {\sqrt {3} - \sqrt {2}}{2}. \\ \end{array}
\]
(2)由旋转体体积公式知
\[
\begin{array}{l} V = \pi \int_ {\sqrt {2}} ^ {2} \left(\frac {\sqrt {x ^ {2} - 1}}{x ^ {2}}\right) ^ {2} d x = \pi \int_ {\sqrt {2}} ^ {2} \frac {x ^ {2} - 1}{x ^ {4}} d x = \pi \int_ {\sqrt {2}} ^ {2} \left(\frac {1}{x ^ {2}} - \frac {1}{x ^ {4}}\right) d x \\ = \pi \left(- \frac {1}{x} + \frac {1}{3 x ^ {3}}\right) \Bigg | _ {\sqrt {2}} ^ {2} = \pi \left(\frac {5}{6 \sqrt {2}} - \frac {1 1}{2 4}\right) = \frac {1 0 \sqrt {2} - 1 1}{2 4} \pi . \\ \end{array}
\]

(1)由 \( (xy-1)\mathrm{d}x+x^{2}\mathrm{d}y=0 \) 整理得 \( y'+\frac{1}{x}y=\frac{1}{x^{2}} \) ，利用一阶线性微分方程的通解公式，可得
\[
y = \mathrm{e} ^ {- \int \frac {1}{x} \mathrm{d} x} \left(\int \frac {1}{x ^ {2}} \mathrm{e} ^ {\int \frac {1}{x} \mathrm{d} x} \mathrm{d} x + C\right) = \frac {\ln x + C}{x}.
\]
又 \( y(1)=0 \) ，则C=0，故 \( y=\frac{\ln x}{x} \) .
(2)由(1)知， \( y=\frac{\ln x}{x} \) ，则
\[
y ^ {\prime} = \frac {1 - \ln x}{x ^ {2}}, y ^ {\prime \prime} = \frac {2 \ln x - 3}{x ^ {3}}.
\]
令 \( y''=0 \) ，解得 \( x=e^{\frac{3}{2}} \) .
又当 \(x > \mathrm{e}^{\frac{3}{2}}\) 时，\(y'' > 0\)；当 \(0 < x < \mathrm{e}^{\frac{3}{2}}\) 时，\(y'' < 0\)。故拐点为 \(\left(\mathrm{e}^{\frac{3}{2}}, \frac{3}{2\mathrm{e}^{\frac{3}{2}}}\right)\)。
由于 \(\lim_{x\to +\infty}\frac{\ln x}{x} = 0\) ，故 \(y = 0\) 为曲线 \(y = y(x)\) 在 \(x\to +\infty\) 时的一条水平渐近线.
由于 \(\lim_{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{\ln x}{x} = -\infty\) ，故 \(x = 0\) 为曲线 \(y = y(x)\) 的一条铅直渐近线.

（1）令 \(G(x) = f(x) - \frac{f(c) - f(a)}{c - a} (x - a)\)
则
\[
G (a) = f (a) = G (c),
\]
又 \(G(x)\) 在 \([a, c]\) 上连续，在 \((a, c)\) 内可导，故根据罗尔定理可知，存在 \(\xi \in (a, c)\)，使得 \(G'(\xi) = 0\)，即 \(f'(\xi) = \frac{f(c) - f(a)}{c - a}\)，原命题得证。
(2)由(1)可知，
\[
\begin{array}{l} \frac {f (b) - f (a)}{b - a} = \frac {f (b) - f (c) + f (c) - f (a)}{b - a} \\ = \frac {f (b) - f (c)}{b - c} \cdot \frac {b - c}{b - a} + \frac {f (c) - f (a)}{c - a} \cdot \frac {c - a}{b - a} \\ = f ^ {\prime} (\gamma) \cdot \frac {b - c}{b - a} + f ^ {\prime} (\xi) \cdot \frac {c - a}{b - a}, \\ \end{array}
\]
其中 \(\gamma \in (c, b)\). 令 \(\frac{b - c}{b - a} = t\), 则 \(\frac{c - a}{b - a} = 1 - t, 0 < t < 1\), 故 \(\frac{f(b) - f(a)}{b - a} = tf'(\gamma) + (1 - t)\).
\( f'(\xi) \) 介于 \( f'(\gamma) \) 与 \( f'(\xi) \) 之间(当 \( f'(\gamma)=f'(\xi) \) 时, 取 \( \eta=\gamma \) 显然得证), 于是, 由导数的介值定理可知, 存在 \( \eta \) 使得 \( \eta>\xi \) , 原命题得证.

questions.stem: 计算 \(I = \iint_{D} x^{2} y^{2} \mathrm{d}x \mathrm{d}y\), 其中 \(D\) 是由直线 \(y = 2, y = 0, x = -2\) 及曲线 \(x = -\sqrt{2y - y^{2}}\) 所围成的区域.

solution.analysis_md:
区域 \(D\) 和 \(D_{1}\) 如图所示.
\[
